shortDescription: Reviews inbound Australian contracts against standard positions, fallbacks and approval thresholds.
longDescription: Configures review playbooks, triages NDAs, reviews commercial agreements, screens ACL and ASIC unfair terms, maps liability and indemnity regimes, prepares negotiation memos and tracks renewals. Keeps future subscription rules separate from current law and requires qualified lawyer review.
defaultPrompt: Create a contract-review playbook from our standard positions, fallbacks and approval thresholds.
Triage this inbound NDA as green, yellow or red against our approved playbook.
Review this MSA and SOW and return a clause-referenced issues table.
Screen these terms for ACL or financial-services unfair-contract-terms risk.
Review how this contract's caps, exclusions, indemnities and insurance interact.
Prepare a negotiation memo with current text, proposed text, rationale and fallbacks.
Build a renewal and notice-date register from these executed contracts.
whatItDoes: Records standard positions, fallbacks and approval thresholds
Returns clause-referenced NDA and commercial review issues
Screens UCT, liability, indemnity and insurance interactions
Prepares negotiation tables and evidenced renewal registers
boundaries: DRAFT - LAWYER REVIEW REQUIRED on every output
No signing, sending, autonomous approvals or live diary updates
Official-source verification at use; future duties separately labelled

requires.australian-legal-research: Verifies Commonwealth and state contract-law provisions at the relevant date.
requires.australian-commercial-drafting: Supplies controlled drafting profiles, the UCT checklist, UTPA notes and drafting alternatives.

handsOffTo.australian-employment-fair-work: Owns employment profiles and worker-status analysis for services arrangements.
handsOffTo.australian-privacy-cybersecurity: Owns privacy jurisdiction, APP and automated-decision analysis.
